notes.title: Axial Ramification Update!
notes.content:
Dear friends of a chemical conundrum!

Another update of Molecule has been released.

Here the list of changes:
- fixed a glitch with axial-symmetric atoms causing some solutions not being considered correctly
- fixed wrong ordering in level selection
- enabled v-sync to increase compatibility
- small cosmetic tweaks

Happy puzzling!

-j

tags.bug: - fixed a glitch with axial-symmetric atoms causing some solutions not being considered correctly
- fixed wrong ordering in level selection

notes.title: Updates, updates, updates
notes.content:
We have been busy improving Molecule!

Changes include:
[list]
[*] improved Steam integration
[*] achievement updates 
[*] fixing a collision bug that broke the world of physics as we know it!
[*] resolving a molecular misalignment to make Nicotine actually solvable
[/list]

Thank you everyone for feedback and suggestions!

[b]Happy Puzzling![/b]
